display.purpose: Hero headline only, one per page.

shadows.name: hover-lift
shadows.purpose: Buttons and clickable cards on hover only; paired with a 2px upward translate.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Main conversion action, e.g. 'Book a discovery call'.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #00753E; color: #FFFFFF; font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 0.9375rem; letter-spacing: 0.01em; padding: 15px 28px; border: none; border-radius: 10px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 200ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1), transform 200ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1), box-shadow 200ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #231F20; transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: 0 8px 20px rgba(35,31,32,0.12); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #00904C; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Coral Button
components.description: Single highest-priority CTA on a page, typically the hero.
components.css: .ds-btn-coral { background: #F15A40; color: #231F20; font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 0.9375rem; letter-spacing: 0.01em; padding: 15px 28px; border: none; border-radius: 10px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 200ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1), transform 200ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1), box-shadow 200ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1); } .ds-btn-coral:hover { background: #D8442B; color: #FFFFFF; transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: 0 8px 20px rgba(35,31,32,0.12); } .ds-btn-coral:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #231F20; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { background: #FFFFFF; color: #231F20; font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 0.9375rem; letter-spacing: 0.01em; padding: 15px 28px; border: 1px solid #E3E5E4; border-radius: 10px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 200ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1); } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: #F6F9F7; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #00904C; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Service Card
components.description: Feature-level card for a service line on a Surface Tint or White section.
components.html:
Accounting & Bookkeeping

Day-to-day ledgers, reconciliations and reporting handled by a dedicated offshore team.
components.css: .ds-card { background: #FFFFFF; border-radius: 16px; padding: 48px 32px; transition: box-shadow 200ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1), transform 200ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1); } .ds-card:hover { box-shadow: 0 8px 20px rgba(35,31,32,0.12); transform: translateY(-2px); } .ds-card-icon { width: 40px; height: 40px; border-radius: 10px; background: #E4F3EA; margin-bottom: 20px; } .ds-card-title { font-family: Poppins, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 1.25rem; color: #231F20; margin: 0 0 12px; } .ds-card-body { font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; font-weight: 400; font-size: 1.0625rem; line-height: 1.6; color: #55565A; margin: 0; }

components.name: Text Input
components.css: .ds-label { display: block; font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 0.8125rem; letter-spacing: 0.02em; color: #231F20; margin-bottom: 8px; } .ds-input { width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box; background: #FFFFFF; border: 1px solid #E3E5E4; border-radius: 10px; padding: 14px 16px; font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; color: #231F20; transition: border-color 200ms, box-shadow 200ms; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #55565A; } .ds-input:focus { outline: none; border-color: #00753E; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px #E4F3EA; }

components.name: Credential Chip
components.description: Named software platform or qualification, e.g. 'Xero Certified'. Never a generic trust word on its own.
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-block; background: #F6F9F7; color: #231F20; font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 0.8125rem; letter-spacing: 0.02em; padding: 10px 16px; border-radius: 6px; }

components.name: Primary Navigation
components.description: Single-row flat navigation, five links maximum, no dropdowns.
components.html: ServicesProcessWhy BangladeshAbout
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; gap: 32px; } .ds-nav-link { font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 0.9375rem; color: #231F20; text-decoration: none; position: relative; padding-bottom: 6px; } .ds-nav-link::after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 0; right: 100%; bottom: 0; height: 2px; background: #00753E; transition: right 150ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1); } .ds-nav-link:hover { color: #00753E; } .ds-nav-link:hover::after { right: 0; } .ds-nav-link-active { color: #00753E; } .ds-nav-link-active::after { right: 0; background: #00904C; }

narrative.overview: The name is the brief: Certa, certainty. The logo mark is an open ring, a C that never quite closes, completed by a short coral dash standing in for the missing arc, like a checkmark of confidence. Everything in this system extends that one gesture: a calm, mostly-neutral field that lets two decisive brand colors do the convincing, rather than a page shouting for attention. This is a system for a skeptical reader, a finance director or practice owner comparing accounting outsourcing partners with three other tabs open, who is scanning for accounting-specific rigor in fifteen seconds: qualifications, named software platforms, jurisdictional familiarity. The system explicitly rejects the territory of ACE Advisory, RBA Chartered Accountants, and RCI Global: dense nested navigation, navy-and-gray safe corporate palettes with no real brand color presence, cramped and inconsistently-spaced sections, and stock-photo warmth standing in for a point of view. It also rejects reading as a generalist BPO; every claim must be accounting-specific.
keyCharacteristics: Mostly white/near-white canvas; green and coral appear with intent, never as decoration
Confident, tight typography carries hierarchy, not boxes or icons-in-circles
Flat by default; depth comes from tonal surfaces and spacing, not drop shadows
One accent color per decision point: green for structure and trust, coral for the single next action
Credibility carried by specifics: named software, qualifications, jurisdictions, never bare adjectives

rules.name: The Contrast-Safe Brand Rule
rules.body: Raw Certa Green (#00904C, 4.1:1) and raw Signal Coral (#F15A40, 3.4:1) both fail AA for small text on white. Use Certa Green Deep for small green text/UI, and pair Signal Coral only with Ink text or use it strictly as a large decorative surface.

rules.name: The One Action Rule
rules.body: Signal Coral marks exactly one action per screen, the primary CTA. If two elements compete for coral, one of them is wrong.

rules.name: The Wordmark-Weight Rule
rules.body: CERTA& is set bold, Advisory sits in a lighter weight underneath. Echo that same bold/light contrast anywhere the two words appear together.

rules.name: The Flat-At-Rest Rule
rules.body: Nothing has a shadow in its default state. Shadows are a response to hover/focus, never a resting decoration.

dos: Do keep navigation to a single flat row, five links maximum, no nested menus.
Do use Certa Green Deep (#00753E), not raw Certa Green, for any small text or white-on-green button.
Do pair Signal Coral with Ink text, never white text, unless the coral element is large/decorative only.
Do let Surface Tint (#F6F9F7) and White alternate section-by-section as the primary rhythm device.
Do cap body paragraphs at 65-75ch and keep one clear idea per section.
Do reserve Signal Coral for exactly one action per screen.
Do back every credibility claim with a specific: named software, a qualification, a jurisdiction, a number.
Do use moderately rounded 10px buttons, not full pills.
donts: Don't use a navy-and-gray safe corporate palette, that is the RBA/ACE/RCI territory this brand explicitly rejects.
Don't build dense, deeply-nested navigation menus that bury the actual offer.
Don't use stock-photo hero imagery as a substitute for a point of view.
Don't add drop shadows to resting cards or buttons, shadows appear only on hover.
Don't set raw Certa Green (#00904C) or raw Signal Coral (#F15A40) as small body text or button-label color on white.
Don't use uppercase tracked eyebrow labels above every section heading.
Don't list or imply HR, EOR, or general BPO services; this is an accounting-only practice.
Don't use full-pill buttons or casual, startup-register copy.
